entries.reason: ITEM_SORT (inventory gather/organize request) is version-absent in gms_v48. The v61 gather sender CWvsContext::SendGatherItemRequest sub_8314D0 @0x8314d0 (GMS_v61.1_U_DEVM.exe, port 13338) has a distinctive shape: if(compartment in [1,5]){ throttle; COutPacket(64)+Encode4(updateTime)+Encode1(compartment) } — and lives in the 0x831xxx secondary CWvsContext send region alongside the sort twin sub_831564. gms_v48 (GMS_v48_1_DEVM.exe, port 13337) has NO 0x831xxx region; every inventory send-helper lives in the 0x70dxxx-0x71xxxx cluster that opens the 500ms exclusive-request throttle sub_4A2518 @0x4a2518. A complete enumeration of that throttle's callers (xrefs_to sub_4A2518, 72 refs, no truncation) yields the inventory senders sub_70D8DE(op55 ITEM_MOVE), sub_70D987(drop), sub_70DA60(op66), sub_70DC8D(op117), sub_70DF2F(op60), sub_70E00B(op61), sub_719DD9(op65 USE_ITEM) — NONE carries the [1,5]-compartment-guarded Encode4+Encode1 gather/sort body. The feature's request senders are therefore not implemented in the v48 client. Stage B carried this as flagged-blocked; resolved n-a here with the complete-enumeration decompile evidence. The matching clientbound results (GATHER_ITEM_RESULT/SORT_ITEM_RESULT) are likewise version-absent (no request path to answer).

ITEM_SORT2 (inventory sort request) is version-absent in gms_v48. The v61 sort sender CWvsContext::SendSortItemRequest sub_831564 @0x831564 (GMS_v61.1_U_DEVM.exe, port 13338) is the [1,5]-guarded COutPacket(65)+Encode4(updateTime)+Encode1(compartment) twin of the gather sender in the 0x831xxx region. gms_v48 has no such sender: the complete xrefs_to sub_4A2518 (500ms exclusive-request throttle) enumeration of the 0x70dxxx-0x71xxxx inventory send cluster contains no compartment-guarded Encode4+Encode1 body, and v48 has no 0x831xxx send region. Note the v48 opcode space cannot host the v61 numbering here anyway: v48 op65 is USE_ITEM (sub_719DD9 @0x719dd9, body-verified), not the v61 ITEM_SORT2 slot. Resolved n-a with complete-enumeration decompile evidence (Stage B flag cleared).

task-139 cash-item-use-pet-skill coverage sweep (IDA session 0bb5f11a, GMS_v48), CORRECTED after code review found the original entry misattributed case-37's payload to case 28. CWvsContext::SendConsumeCashItemUseRequest @0x70e495 dispatches a switch on get_consume_cash_item_type(itemId). Type 28 IS uniquely dispatched (jumptable case 28 @0x7103aa, xrefs_to confirms its ONLY code xref is the switch dispatch @0x70e53c; not folded into the default list 'cases 26,29,32,33,35,44-46'). Its two exit paths were both traced to completion: (a) when sub_71370B() @0x71370b (bare `dword_80D398 != 0` global-flag check) returns nonzero, the arm builds a resource-0x91 string and jumps to the shared 13-way-reused cleanup at 0x711c47 (destroy one ZXString, jmp def_70E53C) — no Encode call; (b) when it returns zero, the arm calls get_field()+sub_711EEB (bare `this[65]` CField member read, not pet-related), and either shows a resource-0x10E notice and exits via def_70E53C (no encode), or (the confirm path) allocates a CUtilDlgEx confirm dialog, formats a value via GetBuffer/sub_461144, and — ONLY on that single path — calls COutPacket::EncodeStr @0x710571 exactly once (one ZXString built from the formatted confirm value, most likely an item price/description string) before jumping to the case-34-shared tail at loc_711D60. The six-EncodeStr Encode1+EncodeStr block at 0x710852-0x7108dc that the original entry cited belongs to a DIFFERENT, independently-dispatched arm: case 37 (label loc_71059E @0x71059e, confirmed via xrefs_to to have its own sole code xref from the same switch dispatch @0x70e53c, distinct from case 28's). Case 28's true body therefore contains exactly one EncodeStr and zero petId/locker-SN EncodeBuffer/Encode8 calls, and neither of its guard helpers references a pet object. Separately, v48's cash-SLOT dispatcher CWvsContext::SendCashSlotItemUseRequest @0x719901 (the structural analog for locker-SN cash items, matching how jms_v185 encodes the pet's locker SN) only routes get_consume_cash_item_type values 8/9/11 to SendActivatePetRequest (give a new pet)/SendActiveEffectItemChange (chair-style effect item)/SendEntrustedShopCheckRequest — none teaches a pet skill. A func_query name_regex '.*[Pp]et[A-Z].*|.*CPet.*|.*GetPet.*' over the whole binary surfaces only PetFoodItemUseRequest, ActivatePetRequest, StatChangeItemUseRequestByPetQ (= PET_AUTO_POT, a different already-covered op), OnCashPetFoodResult, and CPet movement/chat/command handlers — no pet-skill-teach sender exists anywhere in this binary under any opcode. Positive absence.

TRANSACTION (serverbound PLAYER_INTERACTION CRC-attestation reply) is version-absent in gms_v48. The packet exists on GMS v83+ ONLY because the mode-17 clientbound confirm handler CTradingRoomDlg::OnTrade replies to it automatically (v83 @0x7c20bc: COutPacket(123); Encode1(0x14); Encode1(count); {Encode4 itemId, Encode4 crc}...). On v48 the equivalent arm is mode 15, CTradingRoomDlg::OnTrade @0x5e6bd3, reached from the full switch of CTradingRoomDlg::OnPacket @0x5e6a84 (cases 13 put-item / 14 put-money / 15 confirm / 18 meso-limit, no others) — and its ENTIRE body is `this[108] = 1; CWnd::InvalidateRect(this, 0);`. It constructs no COutPacket and calls no Encode*, so there is no CRC attestation to send. Consistent with the serverbound CRC boundary already encoded in libs/atlas-packet/interaction/serverbound/version_gate.go (tradeCrcPresent: absent GMS<=v79, present v83+ and JMS) and with docs/packets/dispatchers/character_interaction_handle.yaml, whose IDA-verified TRANSACTION mode table lists gms_v83/v84/v87/v95 only. The cell previously read verified against CCashTradingRoomDlg::Trade, which is a DIFFERENT packet (the cash room's Trade button, Encode1(0x11) TRADE_CONFIRM) and does not exist on v48 at all — the mini-room factory sub_5458CC @0x5458cc enumerates exactly five room types (1 Omok / 2 MemoryGame / 3 TradingRoom / 4 PersonalShop / 5 EntrustedShop) with a nil default. The stale audit report that named CCashTradingRoomDlg::Trade (a verified-shaped record for a function that is a DIFFERENT packet) is deleted together with this disposition, so it cannot read as live evidence contradicting the n-a cell. See docs/tasks/task-205-player-trade/version-matrix.md.
